title: Rakugaki Jam

summary.en: Doodle on your phone, then fling it onto a shared wall screen — a live, crowd-drawn VJ jam.
summary.jp: スマホに描いた落書きを、壁の共有画面へ投げ飛ばす。みんなで描くライブ VJ。

mine: Designed the doodle-to-wall-screen concept — draw on your phone, fling it onto a shared display
Built the realtime multi-device pairing and sync on Snap Pair and Firebase RTDB
Built the canvas rendering and fling interaction

challenge.en: A room full of people should be able to draw on one screen, but the usual setups fail. Pass a tablet around and everyone else waits; put everyone on a shared whiteboard and the wall fills with half-finished lines. And anything that starts with “install this app” loses most of the room before the first stroke.
challenge.jp: 会場の全員で 1 枚の画面に描きたい。けれど、タブレットを回せば他の人は待つだけ。全員を共有ホワイトボードに乗せれば、描きかけの線が壁を埋めていく。しかも「まずアプリを入れて」と言った時点で、会場の大半は離れてしまう。

solution.en: The phone and the wall do different jobs. Each person draws privately on their own phone, and only a finished drawing is thrown to the wall, where it becomes everyone’s. Joining is a QR scan or a short typed address through Snap Pair — no account, no download — and Firebase Realtime Database carries the drawings.
solution.jp: スマホと壁に別の役割を持たせた。描くのは各自のスマホの中で、壁に送るのは描き終えた絵だけ。壁に出た瞬間、その絵はみんなのものになる。参加は Snap Pair の QR を読むか、短いアドレスを打つだけで、アカウントもダウンロードも要らない。絵の同期は Firebase Realtime Database が担う。

_notes: Thumbnail, still and preview come from the 2026-09 screen recordings (assets/rakugaki-jam/masters/).

cardLine.en: Doodle on your phone, fling it onto the wall.
cardLine.jp: スマホで落書きして、壁へ飛ばす。

oneLiner.en: Doodle on your phone and throw it onto the big screen — a whole room drawing on one wall, with no app to install.
oneLiner.jp: スマホで描いた落書きを、大画面の壁へ投げ込む。アプリを入れずに、その場の全員で 1 枚の壁を描く。
